subject: Kokiri Forest
text: Dropping a bug into the soft earth patch behind the shop on the east end of Kokiri Forest reveals a Gold Skulltula carrying a token.

evidence.quote: Jump down to the bottom level of Kokiri Forest and head for the shop on the east end.  Look for patch of soft earth behind the shop.  Drop a bug in it (remember to recapture one), and kill the Gold Skulltula that appears.  Take it's token, then plant the Magic Beans.

subject: Magic Beans
text: Plant Magic Beans in the soft earth patch behind the shop in Kokiri Forest.

evidence.quote: Look for patch of soft earth behind the shop.  Drop a bug in it (remember to recapture one), and kill the Gold Skulltula that appears.  Take it's token, then plant the Magic Beans.

subject: Farore's Wind
text: Farore's Wind can be cast at the start of the Deku Tree dungeon to warp back immediately after obtaining the Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: If you like, use Farore's Wind at the start of the dungeon so that you can warp right back to the start as soon as you have claimed the Gold Skulltula.

subject: The Trunk
text: Dropping down the hole in the middle of the first floor leads to the sub-basement of the Deku Tree.

evidence.quote: Drop down the hole in the middle of the first floor to reach the sub-basement.

subject: sub-basement
text: Climb onto the stone block on the north side of the sub-basement, jump to the upper ledge, and crawl through the west tunnel.

evidence.quote: Climb up onto the stone block on the north side of the room, jump onto the upper ledge, and crawl through the tunnel on the west side.

subject: Small Nest
text: In the Small Nest, light a Deku Stick on the torch to burn through the webbing in the northwest part of the room.

evidence.quote: Kill the Larva, then light a Deku Stick on the torch and use it to burn through the webbing in the northwest part of the room.

subject: Small Nest
text: Bomb the sealed wall past the webbing and open the door to enter the hidden room.

evidence.quote: Kill the Deku Baba on the other side, then bomb the sealed wall.  Open the door on the other side.

subject: Hidden Room
text: A Gold Skulltula is located to the right of the door in the hidden room, and its token can be retrieved using the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: On the right of the door is a Gold Skulltula.  Kill it and take it's token using the Boomerang, then leave the dungeon and return to the Hyrule Castle Market.

subject: Hyrule Castle Market
text: The Temple of Time is located to the right of the Happy Mask Shop in the Hyrule Castle Market.

evidence.quote: Go to the Temple of Time.  It's to the right of the Happy Mask Shop.

subject: Door of Time
text: Playing the Song of Time on the red carpeting before the Door of Time with all three Spiritual Stones and the Ocarina of Time opens the Door of Time.

evidence.quote:
Stand on the red carpeting, take out the Ocarina of Time and play the Song of Time.

The three Spiritual Stones, together with the Ocarina of Time and the Song of Time, will open the Door of Time.

subject: Master Sword
text: Drawing the Master Sword from its pedestal beyond the Door of Time awakens Link as an adult seven years in the future.

evidence.quote: Run through the door, where you will find a pedestal which contains a Sword in a Stone.  This is, of course, the Master Sword.  Draw the Master Sword from it's pedestal.

When you pulled the Master Sword from it's pedestal, you were not yet ready for it's power.  The Sword placed you in a magical form of sleep for seven years, and in that time Ganondorf took the Triforce of Power (one of the fragments of the Triforce) for his own, and took control of Hyrule.

subject: Rauru
text: Upon waking, Rauru grants Link the Light Medallion and sends him back to the Temple of Time.

evidence.quote: When you awake, you will meet Rauru, the only awakened Sage.  To defeat Ganondorf, the other five Sages must be found and awakened in their respective Temples.  Rauru will give you the Light Medallion, a symbol of his power, and transport you back to the Temple of Time.

subject: Sheik
text: Sheik meets Link at the Temple of Time and advises him to visit Kakariko Village before heading to the Forest Temple.

evidence.quote: Once back at the Temple of Time, you will meet Sheik, the last of Impa's tribe of warriors....Sheik also advises you that, before you run off to the Forest Temple, you head for Kakariko Village, where you will find an item of great value.

subject: Redead
text: As an adult, Hyrule Castle Market is overrun with Redeads, which drop Magic Pots when killed.

evidence.quote: Hyrule Castle Market is now filled with Redeads.  This is actually a good thing - Redeads drop lots of Magic Pots, and this square is so full of them that refilling your Magic Pots is three easy kills away.

subject: Poe Shop
text: The former Gatehouse at the Hyrule Castle Drawbridge contains a Poe Shop where the shopkeeper buys captured Poes and Big Poes and offers the fourth bottle.

evidence.quote: If you want, you can enter the former Gatehouse to find a new Poe Shop, where the shopkeeper will buy your captured Poes and Big Poes.  The most important function of the Poe Shop is it is the place where you acquire the game's fourth and final bottle.

subject: Hyrule Castle Drawbridge
text: The shattered drawbridge remains open day and night leading out to Hyrule Field.

evidence.quote: Head northeast and through the drawbridge, which is now shattered and remains open day or night.

subject: Epona
text: Pay Ingo 10 rupees to enter the paddock, then play Epona's Song to summon the grown Epona.

evidence.quote: Pay him 10 rupees, and when you enter the paddock, ignore the horse that Ingo offers you.  Play Epona's Song, and the now fully-grown Epona will run towards you.

subject: Ingo
text: Speaking with Ingo while riding Epona prompts him to challenge Link to a horse race for 50 rupees.

evidence.quote: Now, speak with Ingo WHILE you are riding Epona (z-target him to make it easier), and Ingo will challenge you to a race for 50 rupees.  Accept the challenge.

subject: Epona
text: Defeat Ingo in two consecutive horse races, then sprint with carrots straight at the closed ranch gate to jump over it into Hyrule Field and claim Epona.

evidence.quote: Defeat Ingo, and he'll challenge you to another race.  And this time, if you win, he'll let you keep Epona....Once you defeat Ingo for the second time, he'll honor his bet, but he'll also prevent you from leaving the Ranch by closing the gate.  To make it over the gate, you must run around the path around the paddock in a counter-clockwise pattern.  Once you come around the corner and see the gate, burn all of your carrots at once and charge straight at the gate....Once you make it over the gate, then you will return to Hyrule Field and Epona will become yours.

subject: Cucco
text: Trampling Cuccos in the northeast corner of the pasture while riding Epona triggers an attacking flock that cannot harm Link while mounted.

evidence.quote: If you want to have some fun, you can also trample on the Cuccos in the northeast corner of the pasture, and a flock of Cuccos will appear and begin to attack you.  But because you're on Epona, they can't hurt you.

subject: Big Poe
text: Big Poes appear across Hyrule Field when riding Epona, but killing them requires the Fairy Bow from the Forest Temple.

evidence.quote: Now that you have Epona, you can spot the Big Poes that appear around Hyrule Field.  You can't actually kill them until you get the Fairy Bow from the Forest Temple, however.

subject: Shooting Gallery
text: The previously unfinished building in Kakariko Village is now completed as the adult Shooting Gallery.

evidence.quote: Notice that the unfinished building is now finished; it contains the new Shooting Gallery.  We'll return here once we get the Fairy Bow for the first Bow Upgrade.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Riding the grown Magic Leaf on the left side of Kakariko Graveyard to the high cliff leads to a crate containing a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Remember where we planted one of the Magic Beans as Young Link?  A Magic Leaf has now appeared there.  Step onto the Leaf to ride up to a high cliff, which contains a crate.  Roll into the crate to find a Piece of Heart.

subject: flowered gravestone
text: Pulling back the gravestone with flowers next to the Magic Leaf reveals a pit.

evidence.quote: Right next to the Magic Leaf, there is a gravestone with flowers on it.  Grab this gravestone from behind and pull it away to reveal a pit.  Drop down into the pit.

subject: fence jumping
text: Jumping over both fences in the Lon Lon Ranch paddock course earns back the 10 rupees paid to ride.

evidence.quote: Pay him 10 rupees, and when you enter the paddock, ignore the horse that Ingo offers you....Jump over both of the fences in the course to make back your ten rupees, then speak with Ingo.
